turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
How do I use it properly the very first time?
For your very first time, keep it simple: apply thin, light, even coats of Whisper Light™ Bond through your natural lashes, wait for it to get tacky (about 15–20 seconds), then place your Gossamer® lashes side-by-side so they line up seamlessly.
Big beginner win: don’t stress about longevity on day one—focus on getting comfy with the Underlash™ method and the Fuse™ Control Wand. Most people feel solid after 2–3 applications.
